newsitem.title: USA: Digital Equipment cuts desktop prices.
newsitem.headline: Digital Equipment cuts desktop prices.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp. Thursday lowered U.S. prices of its personal computers by up to 21 percent.

The new prices meet or beat prices from other leading manufacturers, the company said in a statement. The lower prices also reflect its ability to pass on component cost reductions to customers, it said.
The price cuts affect some of Maynard, Mass.-based Digital's most popular products, including various models of its Venturis and Celebris lines, it said.
The Venturis FX-2 5200M, introduced in May, now has an estimated street price of $1,524, down 21 percent from before.
Digital's stock fell 56 cents to $39.19 on the New York Stock Exchange at midafternoon.
